promptCommit: Review the current checkout changes and commit the appropriate changes with a descriptive commit message, following repository instructions. Do not push or create a PR. Do not amend, reset, discard changes, or include secrets. Ask if the intended scope is unclear.
promptPush: Review the current checkout changes, commit the appropriate changes following repository instructions, and push the current branch to its configured remote.
